title: 1921 SNETA Farman Goliath ditching
summary: SNETA Farman Goliath O-BLAN was operating a mail flight from Croydon to Brussels when at 13:32 a witness heard an explosion and observed the aircraft's structural collapse before it ditched in the English Channel 3 nautical miles off Calais. Both crew members, pilot Paul Delsenne and mechanic Raymond Rijckers, were reported missing and presumed dead. The wreckage was located and a mail bag recovered by a yacht. This was the first Farman Goliath crash in civil service.
